channel.title: Nepocore practical guides
channel.description: Original practical walkthroughs for everyday browser tools.

item.title: JPEG, PNG or WebP: choose a format for the job
item.description: A practical decision guide for photographs, transparent logos and screenshots, with a repeatable export comparison.

item.title: Compress images while keeping the detail people need
item.description: Use dimensions, quality and visual comparisons in the right order instead of chasing an arbitrary file-size target.

item.title: Prepare a passport photo layout without confusing size with approval
item.description: Understand millimetres, pixel dimensions and print scaling before making a photo sheet.

item.title: Turn a photo into a readable pixel-art avatar
item.description: Choose a crop, grid size and color treatment that keep the subject recognizable at small sizes.

item.title: Make a photo comic strip that reads in the right order
item.description: Plan panels, captions and bubbles so the story remains clear on a phone and in a downloaded image.

item.title: Create a transparent signature image and use it carefully
item.description: Draw a clean signature, inspect transparency and understand how it differs from a cryptographic digital signature.

item.title: Design a bold text poster with layered depth
item.description: Use short text, controlled extrusion and readable color contrast to make a useful PNG or SVG poster.

item.title: Make a QR code that still scans after printing
item.description: Keep the quiet zone, choose a clear destination and test the actual printed result before distributing it.

item.title: Export PDF pages as JPG or PNG without losing track of resolution
item.description: Choose page ranges and pixel density, then decide between a single image and a ZIP of page images.

item.title: PDF compression: compare a structure rewrite with an image-based copy
item.description: Understand why a PDF can get larger, and which features an image-based export removes.

item.title: Extract PDF text or use OCR? Start by checking the text layer
item.description: Avoid empty extraction results and understand why columns, scans and reading order need different treatment.

item.title: Build a word search from a list that actually fits
item.description: Choose a grid, useful vocabulary and an answer key, while handling words the generator cannot place.

item.title: Create a connected crossword with clear clues
item.description: Write fair answer–clue pairs, improve intersections and review unplaced words before handing out the puzzle.

item.title: Use a Sudoku generator, checker and hint without guessing what they mean
item.description: Learn the difference between conflicts, wrong entries, uniqueness and clue-count difficulty.

item.title: Make a weekly school timetable that matches the real day
item.description: Build periods and breaks first, then place subjects and check the printable schedule against actual school hours.

item.title: Choose a printable worksheet with one clear practice goal
item.description: Use alphabet, math, handwriting or coloring pages deliberately and check the exported PDF before printing.

item.title: Use a habit calendar without letting a streak become the whole goal
item.description: Record a few clear actions, interpret streaks accurately and keep a backup of optional local records.

item.title: Make a simple room plan before moving furniture
item.description: Measure rectangular footprints, compare positions and understand the difference between no overlap and usable clearance.

item.title: Build a seating chart with capacities you can verify
item.description: Keep guest labels unique, reserve explicit assignments and use fill or shuffle only for the decisions you intend.

item.title: Keep a pantry list without treating dates as a food-safety verdict
item.description: Record quantities, storage locations and package-label dates while keeping calendar comparisons separate from safety decisions.

item.title: Build a monthly budget with planned and actual amounts
item.description: Separate the plan from the record, check the leftover arithmetic and keep all rows in one currency.

item.title: Work out an IPv4 subnet from 192.0.2.143/27
item.description: Follow the block arithmetic, then handle /31 and /32 using their explicitly different interpretations.

item.title: Read chmod numbers without defaulting to 777
item.description: Build owner, group and other permissions from 4–2–1, and interpret directory search and special bits carefully.

item.title: Generate and verify an HMAC with the right bytes
item.description: Distinguish authentication from encryption and compare UTF-8 keys, hexadecimal bytes and exact message content.

item.title: Inspect a HAR network log without sharing its secrets
item.description: Read timing and size summaries, then understand what a reduced export removes and what it can still reveal.

item.title: Compare subscription costs on the same time scale
item.description: Normalize weekly, monthly and annual prices without confusing an average cost with the actual billing date.

item.title: Compare debt-payoff methods under clear assumptions
item.description: See how monthly interest, fixed payments and priority rules shape a simplified snowball or avalanche schedule.

item.title: Compare pack sizes using unit price and the same units
item.description: Convert grams, kilograms, millilitres and litres before comparing a discount with a larger pack.

item.title: Follow cash from opening balance to the next period
item.description: Model receipts and payments in order without confusing cash flow with profit or a balanced monthly budget.

item.title: Keep a manual inventory with stock value and reorder flags
item.description: Use unique SKUs, a defined unit cost and a real count before relying on stock totals.

item.title: Make a business card with a contact QR people can verify
item.description: Keep the visual card readable, distinguish a vCard from a website link and test both the printed and digital contact.

item.title: Print a clear address label and keep postage separate
item.description: Choose a physical label size, preserve every address line and verify the recipient before attaching it to a parcel.

item.title: Count Nepali notes and coins with a denomination check
item.description: Separate note and coin rows, verify the piece count and reconcile a worked NPR total.

item.title: Read a Nepali BS calendar with AD dates and scoped holiday notes
item.description: Use the supported date range, check a known conversion and distinguish a dated holiday from a universal closure.

item.title: Draft a Nepali request letter, then make it your own
item.description: Choose an editable school, office or general request template and check dates, wording and the final PDF.

item.title: Use a scientific calculator in degrees: sin, powers, logs and factorials
item.description: Check degree mode, reproduce worked calculations and understand errors before relying on a scientific calculator result.

item.title: Calculate your IELTS overall band: averaging and rounding examples
item.description: Work through four section scores, .25 and .75 boundaries, and the difference between an overall band and a recipient’s requirements.

item.title: Create a chibi anime avatar with transparent PNG and editable SVG
item.description: Choose illustrated parts, build a readable avatar and check transparent PNG or SVG exports without confusing the builder with a photo-to-anime service.
